correctness.rationale: The finite input domain is exactly 729 rules. A 3x3 primitive matrix has exponent at most 5, so exhaustive exact M^5>0 filtering is complete. Two independent charpolynomial algorithms agree on all 288 survivors, which fall in exactly 16 classes and yield the verified spectral distribution. Six height-three periodic systems are separated, and all others have height one; Gröger–Krawczyk Theorems A/B and Proposition 3.10 then give all eight complexity and tame/null counts. No numerical extrapolation is used.
